idea-plugin.name: Clotr
idea-plugin.description:
Clotr flags credentials in open files as you edit. Credential checks are on by default. Checks for personal details in open files start off and can be turned on in settings.

Use Check my clipboard or Check selection before sharing text. Clotr checks up to 1 MB of text and can copy a cleaned version with Bandage placeholders.

Set up Clotr Guard from Tools or Clotr settings when you want to check prompts and file reads in Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI or Windsurf. Guard setup needs Node.js, previews its changes and waits for your approval.

The plugin runs in the IDE and makes no network calls. It reads .clotrignore at the repository root. Secret files stay silent in the editor. If Git does not ignore a secret file, Clotr shows one project note with an option to add it to .gitignore.

Free and open source under AGPL-3.0-or-later. Source and issues.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• A file or clipboard check that stops early is marked incomplete, so unchecked text does not count as clean.
  • Medical record, Medicare, driver's license and insurance member numbers, your own IP address and gamer tags now wait for the personal details setting. 0.1.1 warned on them with that setting off. Card, card security code, gift card and bank numbers still warn by default.
  • Each copy of a repeated credential gets its own warning and quick fix, but a copy inside a longer word or number doesn't.
  • The status bar counts files open in an editor, and ignore checks read parent rules, repository excludes and the global ignore file.
  • Guard setup works on the project in the current IDE window and explains which assistants changed when setup fails.
  • The skip-pattern list scrolls, Spanish messages match English, and the engine finds more national IDs, access tokens and wrapped credentials.
